title: Fourier weights of parity tuples
statement: Let $n,k,q$ be natural numbers and let $f$ be a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube whose nonzero Fourier coefficients are all indexed by sets of cardinality $k$. Sum, over all ordered $q$-tuples of coordinate sets whose symmetric difference is empty, the absolute value of the product of their Fourier coefficients. This sum equals the sum of the products of the absolute Fourier coefficients over all such tuples in which every coordinate set has cardinality $k$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
Every set indexing a nonzero Fourier coefficient of $f$ has cardinality $k$
